Title: VPN connection fails after Windows update
Description: Several employees cannot connect to the company VPN after installing the latest Windows update. The VPN client displays an authentication timeout error.

Title: Internal API returns HTTP 500
Description: The internal order management API intermittently returns HTTP 500 when retrieving order details. Application logs show database connection timeout errors.

Title: Docker container cannot connect to database
Description: A backend service running in Docker could not connect to its PostgreSQL database because the container was using an incorrect hostname.
Resolution: Updated the database hostname in the Docker Compose configuration and verified connectivity.
